newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Instru 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Instru 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 268 million markka median forecast for medical equipment maker Instrumentarium Oy's 1996 full-year profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(Profit forecasts by 15 analysts, EPS by 13 analysts).
Instrumentarium's results are due on February 18 at 0830/0630 GMT.
In 1995, Instrumentarium had a 225 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 10 of the 15 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 299 million markka (mean 303 million) in a 280-334 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aros Securities, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock, Paribas and Postipankki.
